en.headline: Red flags hoisted at five beaches due to big waves
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department says swimmers should stay out of the water at Stanley Main, Shek O, Big Wave Bay, Silverstrand and Clear Water Bay Second Beach.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced today that red flags have been hoisted at five beaches because of big waves.

The affected beaches are Stanley Main Beach, Shek O Beach and Big Wave Bay Beach in Southern District on Hong Kong Island, and Silverstrand Beach and Clear Water Bay Second Beach in Sai Kung District.
The department said the red flags indicate that swimming is dangerous at these locations and advised beachgoers not to swim there. The announcement was issued at about 9:26am.

zh.headline: 五個泳灘因大浪懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署表示，赤柱正灘、石澳、大浪灣、銀線灣及清水灣第二灣因大浪懸掛紅旗，市民請勿游泳。
body: 康樂及文化事務署今日宣布，由於大浪關係，五個泳灘已懸掛紅旗。
受影響泳灘包括港島南區的赤柱正灘泳灘、石澳泳灘及大浪灣泳灘，以及西貢區的銀線灣泳灘及清水灣第二灣泳灘。
康文署表示，紅旗顯示在該處游泳會有危險，呼籲市民請勿前往游泳。有關公布於上午約9時26分發出。
